calendarFaqs.q: When does CPS start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Chicago Public Schools starts the 2027–28 K–12 school year on Monday, August 23, 2027. Preschool students begin Tuesday, August 24. The first K–12 school day is a full day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Winter Vacation in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: CPS Winter Vacation runs Monday, December 20, through Friday, December 31, 2027. January 3 is a professional development day, so students do not return that Monday.

calendarFaqs.q: When do CPS students return after Winter Vacation?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028. The published Winter Vacation ends December 31, but CPS schedules a professional development day with no student attendance on Monday, January 3.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Spring Vacation in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: CPS Spring Vacation runs Monday, March 20, through Friday, March 24, 2028. Students return Monday, March 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for K–12 students is Friday, June 9, 2028. Preschool students finish Thursday, June 8. The first and last K–12 school days are both full days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CPS professional development and conference days are student days off?
calendarFaqs.a: CPS lists professional development days on September 24, November 1, January 3 and 28, February 22, and April 14. Parent-teacher conference days on November 2 and April 13 are also student non-attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CPS publish separate preschool dates for 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Preschool students begin August 24, 2027, one day after K–12 students, and finish June 8, 2028, one day before the K–12 last day.

calendarFaqs.q: Can emergency days extend the CPS 2027–28 school year?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CPS marks June 13–16 and June 20, 2028, as emergency days when school may be in session if student days fall below the state requirement. Check CPS before making firm plans for those dates.

sourceReviewSummary: District Family Calendar PDF last updated March 5, 2026. MySchoolDates reviewed the current CPS calendar page, Family Calendar, Staff Calendar, and Board-approval announcement on August 19, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: CPS calls the source document its Family Calendar for elementary and high schools, and this page follows the district’s terminology.
The Chicago Board of Education approved the 2026–27 and 2027–28 calendars after CPS received feedback from more than 36,000 students, families, staff, and partners.

The review confirmed the September 23 Q1 progress-report date, the January 3 professional development day, the January 4 student return, the 42/45/42/47 quarter totals, and the June 13–16 and June 20 emergency days.

The Spanish page’s legend repeats 2026 first-day years, but its date grid and Spanish school-calendar paragraph correctly show August 23–24, 2027. This page uses the dates supported by the English page and the Spanish calendar body.
School-specific bell schedules, testing dates, athletics, ceremonies, transportation notices, and program calendars remain outside the districtwide Family Calendar.
sourceMaintainerText: Chicago Public Schools publishes and revises the official district calendar.
